svg.title: A cold key turns 40 readers into 40 identical queries
svg.desc: A three-layer stack with the repository Protocol marked as the swap point tests replace. Below, forty concurrent readers all miss a cold cache and all reach the database — forty calls in 1784 milliseconds, with the fan of arrows crossed out — against the same readers funnelled through a single-flight loader into one database call in 85 milliseconds. A timeline at the bottom shades the stale window between the write and the TTL expiry.
svg.text: A cold key turns 40 readers into 40 identical queries
this window is a business decision, not an accident
every key expiring in the same second
recreates the stampede. Jitter the TTL.
no cache 2 510 ms / 15.9 rps · cache-aside at 90% hits 692 ms / 57.8 rps
...and when the cache is another machine?
